title: A surjection of quasi-compact Hausdorff spaces over an extremally disconnected target which is minimal is a homeomorphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a surjective continuous map of quasi-compact Hausdorff spaces onto an extremally disconnected space which never maps a proper closed subset onto the target is a homeomorphism (author lemma at source lines 5480-5486, label lemma-isomorphism). The proof (source lines 5488-5500) reduces to injectivity, assumes two distinct points with the same image, separates them by disjoint open neighbourhoods, uses closedness of the map and the technical containment to place the image in two disjoint closures, contradicting the extremal disconnectedness (proof lines 5488-5499). The closure contradiction is the substance. H3.
